metadata.description:
Electric man 2 - Flash Game.

Includes the original Electric man 2 by Mr. Clarke (electricman2(www.albinoblacksheep.com).swf)
and includes the original update by Free World Group, Electric man 2HS
(electriman2hsfiles.zip)

"Arrow keys to move
ASD for fight moves
QWE for bullet time slowmotion fight moves

The tournament of voltagen, where combat teams of varying numbers compete against each other to determine th most powerful being in the stick man universe. The current champion has never been beaten.
Any combination of martial arts, street fighting and super human powers can be used to wipe out your opponents. Let the games begin! " .

Interestingly, I discovered a cheat "code" to win a level instantly. ( it was previously discovered, but it seems I accidentally found it again, oops), and it seems to be be absent from the 'HS' edition.
After a match begins, to win instantly, press "Esc" and you will win, except on the tutorial and if you have 0 health.
Supposedly, Electric Man 1 was never completed, and the creator skipped to electric man 2. However, that information is from some fan wiki and as such, provides no sources, so until a source is provided, take it with a grain of salt.
